Hi Jill — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Dev, Laura (vendor ops) and Vivek (legal/finance escalation) so we have the right owners on each item. Below is a short intake checklist and our preferred PO conventions — please review and send the items we call out.

Quick intake checklist (what we need from Acme to create a vendor + issue PO):
1) Completed vendor intake form (attached) — org/legal name, tax ID, remittance address, ACH/bank details or remit email
2) W9 (or appropriate equivalent if non-US) — PDF
3) Primary billing contact + invoicing email address
4) Pricing breakdown by billing period (monthly/annual) and whether you expect a single invoice or multiple line items per feature
5) Any special taxes/withholdings or reseller flow to note
6) Certificate of insurance if required for your program (optional at first pass)

Redwood preferred PO/line-item guidance:
- Default: Issue one subscription line per contracted SKU and include quantity + unit (e.g., 1 x "Redwood Dedicated - 8k tokens/month").
- If you invoice per-feature or per-seat, include an itemized section on the invoice matching the above SKU names.
- For multi-line invoices we ask for: SKU name, unit price, quantity, period covered, and total per line. That reduces reconciliation time.
- Please include our HubSpot deal id (HUB-45829) on the PO/invoice to speed routing to accounts payable.

PO issuance timeline (typical):
- Contract fully executed + vendor record created: 1–3 business days
- PO created by Redwood procurement: 1–2 business days after vendor record is available
- Total expected lead time from signed SOW to PO: ~2–5 business days (may be longer for complex billing models)

Attachments I'm sending here: vendor_intake_form.xlsx (fillable) and redwood_po_template.pdf (our preferred PO layout).

Questions for you:
- Will Acme provide a consolidated monthly invoice or individual invoices per subscription/line?
- Do you need Redwood to include a PO number on the invoice header or in the remit instructions? (We prefer header, but will accept either.)

I'll track this in HubSpot and assign steps to vendor ops. If anything here requires legal review, Vivek — happy to hand off.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
